goal: Make P2P message processing code easier to read and navigate
Break up a thousand-line monolithic function handling incoming messages into separate per-message helpers
agreement: Broad agreement that moving message handlers into separate helpers improves code structure
Verified as move-only refactoring with thread-safety checks and test coverage (pseudoramdom, thomasbuilds, l0rinc)
Conceded objection: separate helpers could add friction over caller assumptions vs a flat switch (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is a move-only refactoring that improves readability and scoping in message processing
Does not fix bugs, enhance protocol performance, or resolve an active hazard
